nodes.description: Constant uint256 prize worth 0.05 ether that the contract must be funded with.
Public dynamic array of addresses that have won the prize; appended to in winPrizeAndFeelGoodAboutSelf.
Payable constructor that requires msg.value >= prize to fund the contract.
Public function that records the caller, checks msg.sender == tx.origin and transfers the entire balance to the caller.
Caller-supplied address used as array element, authorization subject and transfer recipient.
Origin transaction sender used as the only bot-prevention check via require(msg.sender == tx.origin).
payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance) sends the whole contract balance to an attacker-controlled address.

edges.reason: The constructor reads the prize constant to validate the initial funding with require(msg.value >= prize).
msg.sender is pushed into the friends array inside winPrizeAndFeelGoodAboutSelf, letting an attacker write arbitrary addresses into state.
friends.push(msg.sender) mutates the friends state array from within the prize-winning function.
require(msg.sender == tx.origin) uses tx.origin as an access-control gate, which is bypassable by contracts calling through intermediate contracts.
msg.sender is compared against tx.origin, so the authorization decision depends on the transaction origin rather than on an explicit owner check.
The function drains the entire contract balance through an external value transfer after state mutation, without reentrancy protection.
The recipient of the full-balance transfer is the caller-controlled msg.sender, so any address can trigger and receive the payout.
The external transfer to a caller-controlled address may re-enter winPrizeAndFeelGoodAboutSelf before the balance is fully drained.
